meta.description: The competitive home of the eFootball Mobile community: players, clans, tournaments and leagues.

home.title: The Arab clan arena for eFootball Mobile
home.subtitle: Create your player profile, found a clan or join one. Tournaments and leagues are built on this identity.
home.step1Body: Your game ID, name and country. Your identity in every match to come.
home.step2Body: Found a clan with admin approval, or ask to join an existing one.
home.step3Body: Tournaments and leagues arrive next, for players and for clans.
home.clansEmptyBody: Be the first to found a clan on the platform.

register.title: Create an account
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A memorable phrase works well.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgot.sent: If this email is registered, a message will arrive within minutes. The link is valid for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.success: Password changed, and you were signed out everywhere. Log in again.
reset.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Request a new one.

account.title: My account
account.verifyBanner: Confirm your email so you can later create a player profile and enter tournaments.
account.resent: We sent a new confirmation email.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.

common.notFoundBody: It may have been removed, or the link changed.
common.errorBody: Something went wrong while loading. Try again.

player.gameIdNotice: Konami offers no official way to verify who owns an ID, so every ID shows as “not verified” until an admin checks it manually.

profileForm.introCreate: This is what others see on your page and in clan rosters.
profileForm.gameIdHint: As shown on your eFootball profile. English letters, digits and dashes.
profileForm.bioHint: Optional. Favourite position, play style, anything that introduces you.
profileForm.gameIdChangeWarning: Changing your ID removes its verification, if it had one.
profileForm.verifyEmailFirst: Confirm your email first to create a player profile.

upload.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 2 MB. Cropped to a 512×512 square.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.verifyEmail: Confirm your email to create a player profile and join clans.
dashboard.profileEmptyBody: You need a player profile to found or join a clan.
dashboard.noClanBody: Find a clan and ask to join, or apply to found your own.
dashboard.needProfileForClan: Create your player profile first to join a clan.

clans.title: Clans
clans.description: Every approved clan on the platform. Search by name or tag.
clans.emptyBody: Every clan the admins approve will appear here.
clans.members: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {# member} other {# members}}
clans.requestSent: Request sent. The clan leader will reply.
clans.requestMessagePlaceholder: Introduce yourself: position, when you play…
clans.signInToJoin: Log in to ask to join
clans.createProfileToJoin: Create a player profile to ask to join
clans.leaveBody: You’ll lose your role here. You can ask to join again later.
clans.leaderCannotLeave: Transfer leadership to another member before leaving.

apply.title: Apply to found a clan
apply.intro: Admins review every application before a clan appears on the platform. You become the clan leader once approved.
apply.name: Clan name
apply.nameHint: 3–32 characters. Can’t be changed after approval.
apply.tagHint: 2–5 English letters or digits, like EFSC. Used in the clan’s link and can’t change.
apply.descriptionHint: 10–500 characters: who you are and what you look for in members.
apply.contactHint: An https link to a Discord server, WhatsApp group or Facebook page.
apply.pendingTitle: You have an application under review
apply.pendingBody: You can’t submit another until the current one is decided.
apply.inClanBody: Leave your current clan before founding a new one.

manage.title: Manage clan
manage.kickBody: They’ll be removed from the clan immediately.
manage.transferBody: {name} becomes clan leader and you become co-leader. You can’t undo this yourself.
manage.nameLocked: Name and tag are fixed after approval.
manage.notAllowed: This page is for the clan leader and co-leaders.

admin.title: Admin
admin.queueDescription: Pending applications are listed oldest first.
admin.rejectReasonHint: Shown to the applicant. Be specific so they can fix it.
admin.approveBody: The clan is created and the applicant becomes its leader.
